Scene 01 · IntroductionAbout Me

Hi, I’m Faiq! A broadcasting student at Universitas Indonesia with hands-on experience supporting film, documentary, institutional video, and live event productions. I love the operational side of making things happen: production planning, on-set operations, talent coordination, and production logistics. I bring a collaborative mindset to every set and adapt quickly in fast-paced production environments.

Short Film

“Thou, My Daughter”

My roleProducer February – June 2026

I produced this narrative short film end to end, from development all the way to a completed one-day shoot. My biggest production leadership role so far, and the one I’m proudest of.

My responsibilities
  • Production Planning
  • Scheduling
  • Budget Management
  • Crew & Talent Coordination
The story of the production
I had to manage a largely inexperienced crew under a fixed one-day shooting schedule. No room for a day two.
I reinforced key departments with experienced external professionals, then optimized the plan through detailed scheduling and tight crew coordination.
We delivered the entire production on schedule. Every planned scene, completed within one shooting day.
